quick_skim.title: Lookahead Branching for Neural Network Verification
quick_skim.abstract: In this work, we investigate the effect of lookahead branching strategies in neural network verification. We present a general recipe to integrate lookahead into any branch-and-bound verifier and demonstrate how one of the current state-of-the-art branching heuristics, FSB, can be viewed as a special instantiation of the lookahead branching strategy. We also describe how, in addition to improving the quality of branching decisions, lookahead can generate additional lemmas that accelerate verification. We instantiate the method in two representative branch-and-bound-based verifiers (Marabou and $α$-$β$-CROWN), and demonstrate that lookahead leads to consistent speedups in verification time and up to $57\%$ more solved instances. Code is available at https://github.com/ai-ar-research/lookahead-branching.

quick_skim.llm_tldr_en: This paper investigates lookahead branching in neural network verification, presenting a general recipe to integrate lookahead into any branch-and-bound verifier. It shows that lookahead improves branching decisions and generates lemmas, leading to consistent speedups and solving up to 57% more instances. The method is instantiated in two verifiers.
quick_skim.llm_tldr_cn: 该论文研究了在神经网络验证中应用回看分支策略的效果。作者提出了一个通用框架，可将回看分支集成到任何分支定界验证器中。实验表明，回看分支不仅改善了分支决策质量，还能生成额外的引理，从而加速验证过程。在Marabou和alpha-beta-CROWN两个验证器上的测试显示，该方法能持续提升验证速度，最多多解决57%的实例。该工作为将回看分支技术应用于更广泛的求解问题（如SAT求解）提供了可能性。
